experiment: SASRec next-item retrieval on Tenrec QK-video SBR subset

cohort.source_order: grouped user histories; preserve per-user event order
cohort.train_validation_test: train all but last two clicks; validate on penultimate click; test on final click
cohort.candidate_catalog: 77,057 items seen in selected training histories
cohort.history_filter: remove clicks already seen before recommendation
cohort.cold_target_policy: retain users only when validation and test items are in the selected training catalog

model.name: SASRec-style one-layer causal Transformer
model.negative_sampling: one random train-catalog item per positive; exclude training history

baseline: training item popularity, same candidate catalog and seen-item filtering
